-- Rotate an 8-bit value left by k bits, wrapping the high bits around.
-- Blocked: the language notes give no u8 <-> int conversion, and the
-- names tried so far (int(x), u8(n), int.from_u8, u8.from_int, x.to_int())
-- were all rejected by the checker. The body stays unresolved until the
-- real conversion or bit-operation API for u8 is known.
rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
  post k != 0 or out == x
  ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
  ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
  ex rotl8(200, 0) == 200
  unreachable
